hooks.command: p=$(cat); printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eq '(ship-pr|open-pr)\.ps1|gh(\.exe)?[[:space:]]+issue[[:space:]]+close' || exit 0; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf '%s' "$p" | powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-stale-paste-block.ps1"

p=$(cat); printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eq 'gh(\.exe)?[[:space:]]+issue[[:space:]]+reopen' || exit 0; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf '%s' "$p" | powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-issue-reopen.ps1"

p=$(cat); printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eq '(claim-issue|new-branch)\.ps1' || exit 0; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf '%s' "$p" | powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/asana-link-pickupcheck.ps1"
